ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHER_FORM_OLD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHER_FORM_old (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_SELECTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_selection IS
rg_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'PF_GROUP'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 gc_id GroupColumn; 
 h_group_row_count number;
 ref_record_number number;
 curr_group_row number;
 flag number;
 errcode NUMBER; 
BEGIN
 
 flag := 0;
 rg_id := Find_Group(rg_name); 
 IF Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 rg_id := Create_Group(rg_name);
 END IF;

 gc_id := Add_Group_Column(rg_id, 'inter_code',CHAR_COLUMN,5); 
 gc_id := Add_Group_Column(rg_id, 'inter_desc',CHAR_COLUMN,50); 

 go_block('valid_interdictions');
 first_record;
 loop
 if :valid_interdictions.chk_box = 'Y' then
 :ctrl_block2.lv_select := 'TRUE';
 add_group_row(rg_id,END_OF_GROUP);
 curr_group_row := get_group_row_count(rg_id);
 set_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.inter_code',curr_group_row,:valid_interdictions.inter_code);
 set_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.inter_desc',curr_group_row,:valid_interdictions.inter_desc);
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 end loop;
 /* populate user selection back to dvt_block */
 hide_window('window2');
 h_group_row_count := get_group_row_count(rg_id);
 go_block('dvi_block');
 last_record;
 ref_record_number := to_number(:system.cursor_record);
 if :system.record_status = 'NEW' then
 flag := 0;
 end if;
 for i in 1 .. h_group_row_count
 loop 
 :dvi_block.inter_code := get_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.inter_code',i); 
 :dvi_block.inter_desc := get_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.inter_desc',i); 
 create_record;
 end loop;
 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 Delete_Group( rg_id ); 
 END IF; 
 go_record(ref_record_number); 
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE place_group_interdictions IS
 rg_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'TEST_GROUP'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 gc_id GroupColumn; 
 h_group_row_count number;
 ref_record_number number;
 curr_group_row number;
 flag number;
 errcode NUMBER; 
 loc_inter_code varchar2(5);
 chk_status varchar2(50);
 alert_button number;
 sZchapter varchar2(5);
 chp_sysdate date;
BEGIN
 -- AV; 05/26/2011
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 
 set_alert_property('alert_yes_no',ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT,'Do you want to commit now?');
 alert_button := show_alert('alert_yes_no');
 if alert_button = ALERT_BUTTON2 then
 goto end_routine;
 end if;

 :system.message_level := '10';
 message('Working ...',no_acknowledge);
 --pitss synchronize; 
 flag := 0;
 rg_id := Find_Group(rg_name); 
 IF Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 rg_id := Create_Group(rg_name);
 END IF;

 gc_id := Add_Group_Column(rg_id, 'inter_code',CHAR_COLUMN,5); 
 gc_id := Add_Group_Column(rg_id, 'inter_desc',CHAR_COLUMN,50); 

 go_block('dvi_block');
 first_record;
 loop
 add_group_row(rg_id,END_OF_GROUP);
 curr_group_row := get_group_row_count(rg_id);
 set_group_char_cell('TEST_GROUP.inter_code',curr_group_row,:dvi_block.inter_code);
 set_group_char_cell('TEST_GROUP.inter_desc',curr_group_row,:dvi_block.inter_desc);
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 end loop;
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 /* populate user selection back to dvt_block */

 h_group_row_count := get_group_row_count(rg_id);
 for i in 1 .. h_group_row_count
 loop 
 loc_inter_code := get_group_char_cell('TEST_GROUP.inter_code',i); 
 go_block('donations');
 first_record;
 if is_multi_chapter then
 sZchapter := 'ALL';
 else
 sZchapter := :global.chapter_id;
 end if; 
 loop
 if :donations.donor_id is not null then
 don_inter.inter_upgrade_place
 (:donations.donor_id,
 sZchapter, --'ALL',--:global.chapter_id,
 :donations.unit_id,
 :donations.transaction_id,
 loc_inter_code,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 :banner.user_id,
 :ctrl_block.grp_mode,
 :ctrl_block.grp_value,
 :banner.prog_name,
 trunc(chp_sysdate), --:valid_interdictions.eff_date,--trunc(sysdate), -- AV 05/26/2011
 NULL,
 :ctrl_block.comments,
 chk_status
 );
 if chk_status != 'OK' then
 
 insert into program_errors
 ( PROGRAM_ID,MODULE_ID,STATEMENT_ID,ITEM_ID , 
 INSERT_USER ,INSERT_DATE,ERROR_MSG )
 values
 (:banner.prog_name,:donations.donor_id,NULL,loc_inter_code,
 :banner.user_id,sysdate,chk_status);
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 end if;
 end loop;
 end loop;
 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 Delete_Group( rg_id ); 
 END IF; 
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_place_inter',ENABLED,property_false);
/* -- old code now alert is asked first and then processing starts
 set_alert_property('alert_yes_no',ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT,'Do you want to commit now?');
 alert_button := show_alert('alert_yes_no');
 if alert_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 commit;
 if form_success then
 show_error('9163');
 else
 show_error('9162');
 end if;
 end if;
 */
 commit;
 if form_success then
 show_error('9163');
 else
 show_error('9162');
 end if;
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM');
 message('Select group mode or Select from LISTVAL.',no_acknowledge);
 --pitss synchronize;
 <<end_routine>>
 null; 
END;

PROCEDURE query_valid_interdictions IS
q_str varchar2(2500);
t_str varchar2(2500);

begin
 
 --AV; 05/26/2011
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, :ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate);
 else
 :ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 
 
q_str := 'inter_code in ( Select inter_code 
 from valid_interdictions vi,valid_acl_codes va,valid_user_access_classes vu
 where vu.user_id = :banner.user_id 
 and vu.access_class = va.access_class 
 and va.access_code_type = ''INTER'' 
 and va.access_code_value = vi.inter_code 
 and vu.inter_level >= vi.view_level 
 and vi.inter_owner in (''D'',''B'') 
 and vi.upm_flag = ''N''
 and allow_multiple = ''Y''
 and :ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate between vi.eff_date and nvl(vi.term_date,:ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate) 
 and :ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate between va.eff_date and nvl(va.term_date,:ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate) 
 and :ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate between vu.eff_date and nvl(vu.term_date,:ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate)
 union
 Select inter_code 
 from valid_interdictions vi,valid_acl_codes va,valid_user_access_classes vu
 where vu.user_id = :banner.user_id
 and va.access_class = vu.access_class 
 and va.access_code_type = ''INTER'' 
 and va.access_code_value = ''ALL'' 
 and vu.inter_level >= vi.view_level
 and vi.inter_owner in (''D'',''B'') 
 and vi.upm_flag = ''N''
 and allow_multiple = ''Y''
 and :ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate between vi.eff_date and nvl(vi.term_date,:ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate)
 and :ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate between va.eff_date and nvl(va.term_date,:ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate) 
 and :ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate between vu.eff_date and nvl(vu.term_date,:ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate) )';
 
 t_str := ' inter_type = :ctrl_block2.inter_type and inter_code in 
 ( Select inter_code 
 from valid_interdictions vi,valid_acl_codes va,valid_user_access_classes vu
 where vu.user_id = :banner.user_id 
 and vu.access_class = va.access_class
 and va.access_code_type = ''INTER'' 
 and va.access_code_value = vi.inter_code 
 and vu.inter_level >= vi.view_level 
 and vi.inter_owner in (''D'',''B'') 
 and vi.upm_flag = ''N''
 and allow_multiple = ''Y''
 and :ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate between vi.eff_date and nvl(vi.term_date,:ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate) 
 and :ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate between va.eff_date and nvl(va.term_date,:ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate) 
 and :ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate between vu.eff_date and nvl(vu.term_date,:ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate)
 union
 Select inter_code 
 from valid_interdictions vi,valid_acl_codes va,valid_user_access_classes vu
 where vu.user_id = :banner.user_id 
 and va.access_class = vu.access_class 
 and va.access_code_type = ''INTER'' 
 and va.access_code_value = ''ALL'' 
 and vu.inter_level >= vi.view_level 
 and vi.inter_owner in (''D'',''B'') 
 and vi.upm_flag = ''N''
 and allow_multiple = ''Y''
 and :ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate between vi.eff_date and nvl(vi.term_date,:ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate) 
 and :ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate between va.eff_date and nvl(va.term_date,:ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate) 
 and :ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate between vu.eff_date and nvl(vu.term_date,:ctrl_block.s_chp_sysdate) )';
 
 if :ctrl_block2.inter_type is not null then
 set_block_property('valid_interdictions',default_where,t_str);
 else
 set_block_property('valid_interdictions',default_where,q_str);
 end if; 
 go_block('valid_interdictions');
 execute_query;
 if :system.record_status = 'NEW' then
 go_block('ctrl_block2');
 show_error('5205');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

PROCEDURE set_control_block_items(action IN varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.GRP_MODE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.grp_mode',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.GRP_VALUE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.grp_value',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.RG_DEF_CHOICE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.rg_def_choice',action);
 end if; 
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_grp_mode',action);
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_grp_value',action);
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',action);
 if action = 'E' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_grp_mode',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_grp_value',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 end if; 
END;

 vim.inter_type,

RecordGroup.Name: RG_COLL_DATES
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select distinct 
 to_char(coll_date,'MM-DD-YYYY') 
 from donations
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and to_date(:CTRL_BLOCK.CHP_SYSDATE,'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI') - coll_date <= 
(select to_number(parameter_value) 
 from valid_parameters 
 where parameter_code = 'LOV_LIMIT' and 
 parameter_type ='ALL' and
 to_date(:CTRL_BLOCK.CHP_SYSDATE,'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI') between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(:CTRL_BLOCK.CHP_SYSDATE,'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI')+1))
order by 1 desc

RecordGroup.Name: RG_DRIVE_IDS
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select distinct 
 to_char(drive_date,'MM-DD-YYYY'), 
 d.drive_id 
 from drives d,
 donations do 
 where d.chapter_id= :global.chapter_id
 and d.drive_id = do.drive_id 
 and drive_date between (to_date(:CTRL_BLOCK.CHP_SYSDATE,'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI') - 30)
 and (to_date(:CTRL_BLOCK.CHP_SYSDATE,'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI') - 1)
 order by 1 desc

RecordGroup.Name: RG_SET_IDS
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select distinct 
 set_id, 
 drive_id,
 to_char(coll_date,'MM-DD-YYYY') 
 from donations
 where coll_date between (to_date(:CTRL_BLOCK.CHP_SYSDATE, 'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI') - 30) 
 and (to_date(:CTRL_BLOCK.CHP_SYSDATE,'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI')- 1) 
 and donor_id is not null
 and chapter_id =:global.chapter_id
 order by 3 desc
